QuestInfo.name: Behind the Rumor
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p1103006# in the #m27000100# and find out why people think #p1101000# is a traitor.
QuestInfo.1: A gateway in the temple leads to a future world in which #p1101000# joined the Black Mage and invaded Maple World. Tell Empress #p1101000# what you found out.
QuestInfo.2: Empress #p1101000# was shocked by what you told her. She was worried she didn't have the strength to prevent that horrible future from coming true.

0.0: Here's what I found out: Inside the temple there's this Gate to the Future. It's, um, a gate that leads to the future.
0.1: In the future, Empress #p1101000# sent the Knights to attack the people of Maple World. Boy, do they really hate the Empress there. They call her the Axle of Evil.
0.2: But something doesn't add up here. You know the Empress; she'd never do something like that! And something about Shinsoo's voice seemed off in the future...
0.3: There's something I'm missing. I need to go back in there, but you should tell Empress Cygnus everything I've told you.
0.4: I'll give you a document with all the details, so you just have to hand that over to the Empress.
0.5: Sure, the Empress is weak, but she's also really strong, right? How could someone like her become a traitor? There's something else going on here. I just know it.
0.6: Why are you still here? Go to #m130000000#!\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)#n

no.0: That's not funny! Do you know what I had to go through to get this information? I almost got eaten by a crazy mutant future-pig!

1.0: I've been waiting for you. Please, tell me what #p1103006# has found out.

yes.0: This report...is it true? Could there really be a future in which I do such horrible things?
yes.1: How could I be responsible for such evil? And what exactly can I do to prevent a future in which Maple World is destroyed by my own hand?

npc.0: Why are you still here? Do you WANT to get crushed by a giant chess piece? Get back to #m130000000#!

item.0: Haven't you been to the Temple of Time yet? I know it's a dangerous place, but this is important.
